pure.summary: The handler calls virtual modules, so it is not a pure function of the request.

read_only.summary: A write-classified virtual-module call mutates state.

stateless.summary: The handler reads mutable state (a cache or store), so its result is not stateless.

retry_safe.summary: A write happens outside a durable step, so a retry could double it.

deterministic.summary: The compiler could not discharge this property.

has_egress.summary: The handler makes no outbound fetch calls.

no_secret_leakage.summary: secret data flows into response body

counterexample.fix: env vars with sensitive names (SECRET, PASSWORD, KEY, TOKEN) must not appear in responses

no_credential_leakage.summary: credential data flows into response body

counterexample.fix: auth tokens and JWT payloads should not be returned to clients

input_validated.summary: All user input passes a validation step before any egress call.

pii_contained.summary: User input never flows to an external egress host.

idempotent.summary: Non-deterministic or not retry-safe: unsafe for at-least-once delivery.

injection_safe.summary: No unvalidated user input reaches a SQL or HTML sink.

state_isolated.summary: No module-scope mutation in the handler body: requests cannot leak state into one another.

fault_covered.summary: 1 of 3 failable I/O site(s) have no explicit failure path.

results_safe.summary: Every Result.ok access is guarded before the value is used. Checked across 5 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

optional_safe.summary: Every optional value is narrowed before use. Checked across 5 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).

post_only.summary: The route table is empty, dynamic, or contains a non-POST method.

canonical.summary: The handler is in Canonical Normal Form: zero ZTS6xx canonical-profile errors. A non-idiomatic spelling is reported at advisory severity and does not deny this property.

cost_bounded.summary: Worst-path module-call count is bounded by the request. Checked across 5 enumerated path(s) (exhaustive).
